2605.21781.title: Reflective Prompt Tuning through Language Model Function-Calling
2605.21781.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of following instructions and complex reasoning... We propose Reflective Prompt Tuning (RPT), a framework that uses LLM function calling to simulate the iterative workflow of human prompt engineers.

2605.30280.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks
2605.30280.summary: We present Qwen-VLA, a unified vision-language-action model that generalizes across diverse tasks, environments, and robot embodiments.

2605.29801.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety
2605.29801.summary: AgentDoG 1.5 introduces a lightweight framework for aligning AI agents with safety and security constraints.
